Donald Trump
as the midterm elections approach.
"Trump hates every one of you," Scaramucci, founder of
SkyBridge Capital
, wrote on X, adding that Trump "detests all of you." The post cited no specific policy, vote or incident. His claims about Trump’s feelings are his opinion.

GOP Senators: Trump hates every one of you. He will stick it in your faces. He knows you won’t shut him down. Taunting. Teasing you. Provoking. Because he detests all of you and wants you and anyone else who humiliated. When will you stop him?

Almost an hour earlier, Scaramucci wrote, "He has betrayed us," while sharing a Fox Business report on Trump’s announcement Friday that Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed to supply over 300,000 tons of diesel immediately, and more later.
He has betrayed us
From Trump Loyalist To Outspoken Critic

Scaramucci met Trump in 1995 and joined his 2016 campaign. Trump fired him as communications director after 11 days in 2017. Scaramucci broke with Trump in 2019 and endorsed Kamala Harris in 2024. He has praised Trump’s crypto agenda but criticized his tariffs and foreign policy.
Scaramucci Has Pressed GOP Senators Before
He has made similar appeals. In February, he urged congressional Republicans to "break ranks" with Trump, calling him "deeply unpopular."
In March, he asked Sen. Majority Leader
John Thune
(R-S.D.) and Sen.
Mitch McConnell
(R-Ky.), "Where is your backbone?" In a post that did not name Trump, he cited the country’s "removal procedures" and said the founders "built the exit door."
I have one question for the Republican Party today.
Where is your backbone?
Thune. McConnell. All of them. Where are you?
Mitch McConnell is 84 years old. He has nothing left to lose. No more elections to win. No more favors to collect. No more political future to protect.…
Republicans Fight To Hold Senate Majority As Midterms Near
Scaramucci’s warnings come as Republicans work to defend their Senate majority. Democrats need to flip four seats to retake the chamber.
